<!-- pr-reviewer: b8ad34b12068dc26cbb0b0f36d27a73793cf64d1 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Safety question: the changed test does not weaken any refusal.

What looks good
- Only two files change: the test file `crates/ui/src/egui_app/rest_pocket_tests.rs` and `docs/decisions/2302-rest-pocket-zigzag-test.md`. No product source file changes.
- `rest2d::rest_strategy` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest2d.rs:256`) returns `Ok` for Auto, Waterline, OffsetRings and Zigzag. It refuses only Adaptive. The test now matches this.
- Zigzag with rest: the test asserts no named refusal, no "Apply will be refused" hint, a commit on Apply, strategy Zigzag, and no operation error. This is the new legal behaviour.
- Adaptive with rest: the test keeps every refusal assert. It checks the named refusal, the warning, the Apply hint and the error on Apply. It adds two asserts: the live strategy stays Zigzag, and the committed rest value is unchanged. The old test only checked `live_rest == None`.
- Pre-drilled with rest: the warning, hint and exact error text are unchanged. The old `live_rest == None` assert cannot hold now, because Zigzag committed first. The new assert is `live_strategy == Zigzag`. The draft strategy is Auto, so a committed Apply would change it. The assert still detects a wrong commit.

Results merged with main (locally, no runner)
- Trial merge with `origin/main`: already up to date, no conflicts.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- rest_pocket_tests`: 6 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run: the full `camcraft-ui` suite, other crates, the batch gate, any GUI.

Requested before merge
- None.

Notes (not blocking)
- The pre-drilled case could also assert `live_rest == Some(committed)`, like the Adaptive case. This is optional.
- The test file has 400 lines, at the limit. Do not add more to it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
